thread:
hana: opened PR w/ tiny addendum for onprem docs: (1) systemd RequiresMountsFor drop-in for offline bundles, (2) nftables ordering note for host->pod forwarding, (3) unix-socket perms + socat debug bridge example. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/421 (draft).

omar: paste the exact snippets so I can check wording.

hana: systemd drop-in we propose:
```
# /etc/systemd/system/redwood-install.service.d/wait-offline.conf
[Unit]
RequiresMountsFor=/mnt/offline-bundle
After=network-online.target
[Service]
ExecStartPre=/usr/bin/test -d /mnt/offline-bundle
```

hana: nftables note (verify ordering): `sudo nft list ruleset` and suggest adding host prerouting rules ahead of kube-proxy priorities.

omar: add conntrack debug commands: `cat /proc/sys/net/netfilter/nf_conntrack_max` and `conntrack -L | wc -l`.

hana: unix-socket perms + socat debug bridge:
```
# ensure permissions for redwood user
chown redwood:redwood /var/run/redwood-kms/proxy.sock && chmod 660 /var/run/redwood-kms/proxy.sock
# debug bridge (local only):
socat UNIX-LISTEN:/var/run/redwood-kms/proxy.sock,fork,mode=660 TCP-LISTEN:8200,reuseaddr
```

omar: please warn folks: don't run socat bridge in prod; show systemd socket activation as more robust option. add small JS SDK example env-first fallback to socket.

hana: done, plus HSM tip: avoid hardcoded vendor paths; use `find / -name "libpkcs11*" 2>/dev/null` and `pkcs11-tool --module $MODULE -L`.

docs-ci: PR 421 CI: spellcheck OK, linkcheck warning for external vendor page, preview pending.

hana: thanks - ping me after review. kept thread concise per docs rules. :white_check_mark:
